button.name: R_lightning
button.label: Reset group
button.tool_tip: Reset every setting in this section to its default. Ground Strike and Advanced below have their own buttons and are not touched

check_box.name: CB_SSAtmoLightning
check_box.label: Enable lightning
check_box.tool_tip: Viewer-side switch; the environment's own Lightning checkbox is the sky's, and either one off is off

button.name: strike_now_button
button.label: Strike Now
button.tool_tip: Fire a strike in front of the camera at a random visible distance, with a 3 second lead. Needs Atmo Magic and lightning enabled

button.name: strike_ground_button
button.label: Ground Strike
button.tool_tip: Fire a cloud-to-ground strike where the camera ray through the lower third of the screen meets land or a build, with a 3 second lead. Needs Atmo Magic and lightning enabled

button.name: R_lightning_advanced
button.label: Reset group
button.tool_tip: Reset every setting in this section to its default, the bolt texture field included

check_box.name: CB_SSAtmoLightningPolarity
check_box.label: Seasonal charge and rate
check_box.tool_tip: Temperature drives lightning's charge and frequency: warm summer skies strike freely as negative cloud-base bolts, the cold of winter throttles lightning down and shifts it to rare positive anvil bolts - launched from the top of the storm, far more powerful, firing as a rapid series of quick pulses

check_box.name: CB_SSAtmoLightningBlue
check_box.label: Bolt from the blue
check_box.tool_tip: Look ahead at the weather cube's next keyframe: while a storm approaches from upwind, lightning and distant rumble arrive from that direction before the storm does, positive bolts striking the ground miles from their cloud

check_box.name: CB_SSAtmoLightningOcclusionCull
check_box.label: Skip hidden ground shows
check_box.tool_tip: Ask the GPU whether a ground strike's crawl, sparks, fire and aura are wholly hidden behind scene geometry and skip building them while they are; the scene light, flash and sound are never affected
